# uiux-asset — UI component code for agents
https://uiux.giatbh.io.vn holds 5621 UI components with real source code. Do NOT open gallery pages (they are huge). Use the two endpoints below; every response is size-capped.

Sources: patterns 194, galaxy 3802, components 25, motion 27, scroll-effects 64, ui-moments 154, namethatui 123, ui-libraries 153, lucian 480, shadcn 61, coss 56, magicui 80, kibo 41, bencho 48, tactile 6, radix 58, preline 28, react-bits 221.

## 1. Find (JSON, <=12 results, <3 KB, no code)
GET https://uiux.giatbh.io.vn/api/find?q=<words>[&k=8][&source=<src>]
-> {"results":[{"id","name","source","kind","kb","parts":["html","css",...],"license"}]}
Example: https://uiux.giatbh.io.vn/api/find?q=toggle+switch&k=5
Example: https://uiux.giatbh.io.vn/api/find?q=dock&source=bencho

## 2. Get code (text/plain, one component, <=12 KB per call)
GET https://uiux.giatbh.io.vn/api/get?id=<id>[&part=html|css|js|ts|tsx|all][&offset=<n>]
First line = header comment (source, license, original URL). Bigger code ends with
"/* truncated: N KB total, use &part= or &offset=<n> */" -> repeat with that offset or fetch one part.
Example: https://uiux.giatbh.io.vn/api/get?id=shadcn/switch&part=tsx

Respect each component's license (in the header). Shell helper: uiux find "<q>" ; uiux get <id> [part]
